title: Pure Toon
summary: Pure Toon build led by the November 2026 Magnificent Maestros cards. Perfect Toon World counts as Toon World in the Field Zone and searches a Toon card every turn, while Funny Dark Rabbit, Evil Box, and Animimicat are treated as Toon monsters while Toon World is on the field, so they switch on Toon Terror and attack-directly effects without the old summoning conditions.

summary.title: Starters
points: Funny Dark Rabbit takes a Toon Field or Continuous Spell from the Deck once per turn and adds it to the hand or places it face-up on the field (Perfect Toon World or Toon Kingdom), and grants an extra Normal Summon for a monster that mentions Toon World.
Perfect Toon World adds 1 Toon card, or 1 card that mentions a Toon card by name, from the Deck to the hand during your Main Phase.
Toon Table of Contents (Limited) searches any Toon card, and Toon Bookmark (Limited) searches any card that lists Toon World, including Perfect Toon World and every new monster.

Animimicat Tributes 1 monster as a Quick Effect in either Main Phase (an opponent's monster if you control Toon World) to Special Summon a monster that mentions Toon World from the hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

summary.title: Opening: Funny Dark Rabbit
steps: Normal Summon Funny Dark Rabbit and use its effect to place Perfect Toon World from the Deck face-up in the Field Zone.
Use Perfect Toon World to add Evil Box from the Deck; Evil Box Special Summons itself because you control Toon World, then adds or Sets Toon Terror from the Deck.
Use the Rabbit's extra Normal Summon on Animimicat (or another monster that mentions Toon World) and Set Toon Terror.

On the opponent's turn, Toon Terror negates one activation, Evil Box puts a card from either GY on the bottom of the Deck as a Quick Effect, and Animimicat Tributes one of their monsters to Special Summon Toon Black Luster Soldier or Toon Dark Magician from the Deck.

summary.title: Cartoon Shade & Tribute Toons
summary.text: Cartoon Shade Special Summons itself from the hand while a monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set is face-up on the field (Red-Eyes Toon Dragon, Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon, or Toon Dark Magician Girl) and searches a monster with 2000 ATK or DEF that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, such as Toon Dark Magician Girl. When Cartoon Shade on the field is Tributed, for Animimicat or for a Tribute Toon, it returns 1 card on the field to the hand, or 2 if you control a monster with 2000 ATK or DEF.

summary.title: Bosses & Direct Attackers
points: Blue-Eyes Toon Ultimate Dragon is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by shuffling Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon and 2 Toon monsters from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck; it lets all your Toon monsters attack directly and adds a Toon card from your GY to the hand each turn.

Toon Black Luster Soldier Special Summons itself from the hand by Tributing Toon monsters totaling Level 8 or higher (or via Animimicat, Toon Page-Flip, or Toon Dark Magician), can attack directly with Toon World on the field, and banishes 1 card on the field each turn.
Toon Dark Magician discards a Toon card to either Special Summon any Toon monster from the Deck ignoring its summoning conditions or search any Toon Spell/Trap.

Toon Harpie Lady Special Summons itself while you control Toon World and destroys a Spell/Trap if you control another Toon; Red-Eyes Toon Dragon Special Summons a Toon monster from the hand ignoring its summoning conditions.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Perfect Toon World can banish a Toon monster you control until another card's effect finishes resolving, once per turn for each original monster name, so removal and targeting effects miss it.

Toon Kingdom also becomes Toon World on the field, prevents the opponent from targeting your Toon monsters with card effects, and banishes cards from the top of your Deck face-down instead of letting a Toon monster be destroyed.

Mind Scan keeps the opponent's hand revealed while you have a Toon card on your field or in your GY, and with a Toon monster and a Toon Spell on your field or in your GY it negates the activated effects of 1 declared card name for the turn. Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage discards itself to place Mind Scan from the hand or Deck face-up on your field.

Toon Terror is an omni-negate Counter Trap while you control both Toon World and a Toon monster, Toon Page-Flip reveals 3 Toon monsters with different names from your Deck and Special Summons 1 at random, and Comic Hand steals an opponent's monster while you control Toon World.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Black Stone of Legend package, the original Toon World, and the older Tribute Toons (Toon Mermaid, Toon Summoned Skull, and Toon Cyber Dragon) made room for the November 2026 cards. The page's older combo lines that splash Synchron, Charmer, Horned Saurus, Kaitoptera, and Sorcerer of the Swamp engines are omitted to keep the list pure.
